messages:
Anika: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: org evolution doc. Two questions: 1) Where will the infra SRE headcount be allocated after the reorg — eng-infra or eng-sre? 2) For the new TL roles mentioned, what's the expected hiring timeline and whether those are net-new headcount or relocations? Appreciate any clarification. :wave:
Miguel: Short answer — infra SRE will sit in eng-infra for ownership but will maintain a dotted-line to eng-sre for oncall & runbook standards. We wanted the product-facing infra work closer to platform owners.
Deepti: Adding context: We're converting 4 contractor positions into 3 full-time IC roles and 1 TL (manager IC hybrid). Those are net-new within the FY26 headcount plan but within existing budget reallocation; not a company-wide increase beyond what's been published.
Anika: Thanks — when does the TL hiring start? Are job descriptions up?
Priya: We have JD drafts. Targeting sourcing to start Week of Apr 20 (roughly 4 weeks). Interview panels will include a platform eng, a product PM, and an SRE lead. We're prioritizing internal transfers first. I'll drop the JD link: https://docs.internal/redwood/org-evolution/jds (internal).
Josh: For product teams impacted: we will run 2-week shadow rotations before permanent moves — so operational coverage remains. If you manage impacted ICs please sync w/ Priya + me.
Deepti: FYI, promotion/banding guidance: TL is IC4->IC5 mapping; salary band stays within existing plan. Relocation support is case-by-case.
Anika: Helpful — any change to hiring freeze / approvals?
Miguel: No change to the freeze policy overall; two exceptions: (a) critical ops hires (like SRE infra) are approved via a fast-track with Eng+People co-sign, (b) replacements for roles vacated due to transfers are greenlit. All exceptions recorded in the hiring tracker.
Priya: For transparency, I'll publish an updated headcount table in the hiring tracker by EOD Friday. Anyone who wants a row unlocked for transfers DM me.
ben-deploy-bot: Hiring tracker updated: https://hr.redwood/hiring-tracker — 4 rows changed.
Priya: Also note: candidates for TL will have an exercise focused on oncall/process design — expect ~90 min take-home + 60 min interview.
Anika: Thanks all, super helpful. I'll share this back to my team. :thumbsup:
